-- Top-selling product (by quantity) among customers who bought 'Youtube Men’s Vintage Henley' in July 2017, excluding that product itself.
WITH july_tables AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE
    _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
),
 -- explode sessions -> hits -> items and keep only item-level purchases (itemQuantity > 0)
 session_items AS (
  SELECT
    fullVisitorId,
    visitId,
    hits.hitNumber AS hitNumber,
    item.productSKU AS productSKU,
    item.productName AS productName,
    IFNULL(item.itemQuantity, 0) AS itemQuantity
  FROM
    july_tables,
    UNNEST(hits) AS hits,
    UNNEST(IFNULL(hits.item, [])) AS item
  WHERE
    IFNULL(item.itemQuantity, 0) > 0
),
 -- find visitors (customers) who purchased the target product
 customers_with_target AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    fullVisitorId
  FROM
    session_items
  WHERE
    LOWER(productName) = LOWER('Youtube Men’s Vintage Henley')
),
 -- all purchases by those customers in July 2017, excluding the target product
 purchases_by_these_customers AS (
  SELECT
    si.productSKU,
    si.productName,
    SUM(si.itemQuantity) AS total_quantity
  FROM
    session_items si
  JOIN
    customers_with_target c
  USING (fullVisitorId)
  WHERE
    LOWER(si.productName) != LOWER('Youtube Men’s Vintage Henley')
  GROUP BY
    si.productSKU,
    si.productName
)
SELECT
  productSKU,
  productName,
  total_quantity
FROM
  purchases_by_these_customers
ORDER BY
  total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1

    CASE

          WHERE h.product IS NOT NULL

          WHERE h.product IS NOT NULL
